findings.problem: The proof repeats the same coefficient-to-base argument for A and C, then repeats the same coefficient-to-tangent argument for them. Two local helper facts can express these conversions once without hiding their mathematical content.

Replace the proof body with:
by
  have base_mem (p : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L)
      (hp : ∀ α, coefficients p α ∈ U) :
      dualBaseLinear (dualEvalLie t h p) ∈ U := by
    rw [dualEvalLie_base]
    exact (eval_mem_iff_coefficients U.toSubmodule p).mpr hp t
  have tangent_mem (p : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L)
      (hp : ∀ α, coefficients p α ∈ V) :
      dualTangentLinear (dualEvalLie t h p) ∈ V := by
    rw [dualEvalLie_tangent]
    exact (eval_mem_iff_coefficients V _).mpr
      (directionalDerivative_mem_coefficientSubmodule V h p hp) t
  have he := F.derivative_removal_preserves_quotient_layers U V hUV j
    (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A) (polynomialFirstJetHom t h C)
    (base_mem A.coord hAU) (base_mem C.coord hCU)
    (tangent_mem A.coord hAV) (tangent_mem C.coord hCV)
    small rational hsmall hrational
  simpa only [polynomialFirstJet_base, polynomialLogDerivative] using he
findings.benefit: Readers see each conversion proved once, followed by an explicit application to A and C. The coefficient, evaluation, and derivative reasoning remains visible, with no additional automation or assumptions.

theorem dualEvalLie_base (t h : σ → ℚ) (p : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L) :
    dualBaseLinear (dualEvalLie t h p) = eval t p := by

theorem dualEvalLie_tangent [Fintype σ] (t h : σ → ℚ) (p : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L) :
    dualTangentLinear (dualEvalLie t h p) = eval t (directionalDerivative h p) := by

theorem eval_mem_iff_coefficients (U : Submodule K V) (p : VectorPolynomial σ K V) :
    (∀ x : σ → K, eval x p ∈ U) ↔ ∀ α, coefficients p α ∈ U := by
